headlines.title: Altria Group (MO) Weighs All Cash Tobacco Deal That Could Reshape Competition
headlines.summary: Altria Group (NYSE:MO) is weighing an all-cash takeover offer for UK-based tobacco group Imperial Brands, according to early discussions. Management is examining options to acquire either the entire Imperial Brands business or select assets instead of a full purchase. Altria has publicly acknowledged that talks are preliminary, with no binding agreement or transaction terms announced as of 27 November 2026.

headlines.title: Japan Tobacco shares surge on report of Imperial Brands takeover
headlines.summary: Investing.com-- Japan Tobacco shares rose on Friday following a report that it and Altria Group are considering a joint takeover of Britain’s Imperial Brands.

description: Altria Group, Inc., through its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells smokeable and oral tobacco products in the United States. It offers cigarettes primarily under the Marlboro brand; large cigars and pipe tobacco under the Black & Mild brand; moist smokeless tobacco and oral tobacco products under the Copenhagen, Skoal, Red Seal, and Husky brands; oral nicotine pouches under the on! brand; and e-vapor products under the NJOY ACE brand. The company sells its products to distributors, as well as large retail organizations, such as chain stores. Altria Group, Inc. was founded in 1822 and is headquartered in Richmond, Virginia.
